# NMJ Group

> Qatari diversified holding company. Eight companies across four sectors. Headquartered in Doha. Established 1991.

## About
NMJ Group (rebranded from Dania Group in 2026) is a privately held Qatari diversified holding company. It operates eight subsidiaries across four business sectors in Qatar, Kuwait, and the United Kingdom. The group's operating history began in 1991 with the founding of Al Emara Al Islamiya.

## Subsidiaries
- Sapphire Plaza Hotel (Hospitality) — https://sapphire-hotels.com
- Steak Town (Hospitality) — https://steaktown.qa
- Al Anaqa (Hospitality) — https://alanaka.qa
- Dania Maids (Hospitality, est. 1998, BICSc accredited) — https://dania-maids.com
- Dania Real Estate (Real Estate, est. 1997)
- Al Emara Al Islamiya (Contracting, est. 1991) — https://alemara.qa
- Next IT (Technology) — https://nexitglobal.com
- Five Nodes (Technology) — https://fivenodes.ai
